question: What splendor characterizes a diagram worshipped in the right-hand mode?
premises: A diagram worshipped in the right-hand mode is specified.
Its splendor is compared to the sun and fire.
inference: A diagram worshipped in the right-hand mode has splendor equal to the sun and fire.
plain_english: A diagram worshipped in the right-hand mode has splendor equal to that of the sun and fire.
